task: Lazy-load React overlay split from Three.js init

measurement_environment.note: FCP-on-Slow-3G measurement requires real browser harness; deferred to Matt's pickup. Bundle-size deltas captured below as the load-bearing acceptance signal.

lazy_chunks.name: client-*.js (react-dom)
lazy_chunks.load_trigger: Promise.all(import) on game-complete or App.js mount

implementation.rationale: components/index.js used to statically import App.js, which dragged App + its sync deps (i18n init, SceneSwapOverlay, GameBridge tree) into main. main.js separately statically imported react + react-dom for the completion overlay. Both deferred to runtime now.
implementation.false_start: First cut used requestIdleCallback({ timeout: 1500 }). Smoke test failed because Chromium starves idle callbacks while WebGL boot keeps the main thread busy — even with the timeout flag. Switched to setTimeout(0) which is reliable.

tests.vitest: 208 pass (was 201 pre-Phase B; +7 cinema-runner specs from Phase B)
tests.playwright_smoke: 2/2 pass (launches start screen + solo classic game canvas renders)

follow_ups_for_matt.fcp_slow_3g_measurement: DevTools Performance tab against deployed sheepdogsim.com with Slow 3G throttling — record TTFB → FCP → first frame painted on the lazy-load build vs the v2.1.2 baseline. Target -800ms minimum to claim a perf win on top of the bundle-delta win already in this commit.
